ford's tavern, in George Town, a Tract Of

sum recorded in said deed.

George Town, and the city of Washington,
and the Island, part Of the property, contain-
ing 500 acres, is known by its produc-
tions to be the most valuable and desirable
land in either the states Of Maryland or Vir-
GINA, with proper cultivation may be made

great proportion Of this tract is heavily TIM-
bered, from which an inexhaustable quantity
of ship timber, staves, &c. may be taken.
The property will be shewn on application to
Mr. John W. Bronaugh, in George Town, Or
Mr. Daniel M'Carty, on the premises. The
terms of sale are, one third cash, or negotia-
ble paper in the bank Of Columbis, at so days
WITHIN two approved electors residing within
the district of Columbia;—the balance in three
equal payments of three, six, & nine months,
all bearing interest from day Of sale, in notes
as above mentioned. The land is To remain
bound, and be resold On default of payment,
for so much ready money as may be sufficient
to raise the balance then due, and the residue
on a credit to meet the future installment or
installments the proceeds of which resale is
to be in like manner secured, and this opers-
tion Of resale is to be made as often as such
successive default shall require conforming
each to the terms prescribed for the first.
